تنتقدين (form VIII)
# تَنْتَقِدِينَ (tantaqidīna) /tan.ta.qi.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
# تُنْتَقَدِينَ (tuntaqadīna) /tun.ta.qa.diː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِنْتَقَدَ (intaqada)
